parsed.notes:
The qualifications section defaults to required; “Interesse daran” makes the learning-oriented data/cloud bullet optional, and “sind von Vorteil” makes the Azure infrastructure bullet optional.
Cloud also appears in an explicit experience requirement, so required wins. Networking likewise has an explicit required mention.
The posting explicitly recruits multiple experience levels, from Professional through Principal; no single seniority is assigned.
Coding-agent tools are independently requested in qualifications. Technologies appearing only in responsibilities, including DevOps, are excluded.
Azure Machine Learning is treated literally as a named Azure service, not as a request for generic machine-learning expertise. Azure storage services do not imply object-storage expertise.
Unmapped Azure infrastructure technologies are optional; unmapped Azure Machine Learning, Data Factory and Synapse Pipeline are appetite-governed optional skills. Vibe Engineering is required and retained separately because the taxonomy does not explicitly cover that named practice.
“Data-Technologien” is too nonspecific to identify an additional technical skill. Debugging Docker images is not expanded into a separate software-testing requirement.
